manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Conspiracy, Wick triggers, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
Repeat step 3.
NOTE: This combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if the combo is not interacted with.
